dialogues.speaker: Opened Secret Letter
dialogues.text: "I wouldn't forget you when there's money to be made. The intel's solid, but we might have competition. It's at Blue Amber Lake. I'll scout ahead, you bring backup."

dialogues.speaker: Opened Secret Letter
dialogues.text: "I'm in dire straits right now, so I might not be able to give you your usual cut. But I swear, I'll pay you back double when things get better."
